tests.name: Exploit Reproducer — Well-formed payload without server capability
tests.attackVector: Caller crafts syntactically valid GitHubWorkflowRunEvidence with valid 64-hex responseDigest and calls mintCiAttestationToken without internal capability.
tests.mitigationMechanism: mintCiAttestationToken checks for TRUSTED_ORCHESTRATOR_CAPABILITY; returns swai_ci_untrusted_* prefix. verifyAuthenticCiProof fails closed with CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED.

tests.name: Direct HMAC Stolen Key Attack — Valid HMAC signature on unauthenticated run
tests.attackVector: Attacker steals or knows KH02_CI_VERIFIER_SECRET and computes valid HMAC signature directly on fabricated run payload.
tests.mitigationMechanism: verifyAuthenticCiProof enforces lookupVerifiedRemoteCiRun. Without authentic registration in VERIFIED_PROVIDER_RUNS via verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun, run is rejected.

tests.name: Bypass Removal — verifyGitHubActionsRunProof with requireTrustedVerifier=false
tests.attackVector: Caller sets requireTrustedVerifier: false in options to bypass provider verification.
tests.mitigationMechanism: Removed requireTrustedVerifier bypass flag from validator logic; providerVerified strictly requires lookupVerifiedRemoteCiRun.

tests.name: Exact Numeric RunId Binding — runId mismatch in GitHub API response
tests.attackVector: Attacker injects or proxies API response where requested runId differs from data.id.
tests.mitigationMechanism: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun asserts String(data.id) === runIdStr before registering.

tests.name: Exact Workflow Matching — Substring workflow name matching eliminated
tests.attackVector: Attacker runs malicious workflow named 'Evil KH-02 Continuous Integration Trigger' relying on substring containment.
tests.mitigationMechanism: assertAllowedWorkflow enforces exact match against CANONICAL_RELEASE_WORKFLOWS list.

tests.name: Authentic Provider Run Lifecycle — Genuine run registration and lookup
tests.attackVector: Verifies that legitimate GitHub API verification lifecycle properly registers run record and allows valid attestation lookup.
tests.mitigationMechanism: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun registers record in VERIFIED_PROVIDER_RUNS and mints token with TRUSTED_ORCHESTRATOR_CAPABILITY.

tests.name: Mock Quarantine — UNIT_TEST_MOCK quarantined from commercial CI_PASS
tests.attackVector: Test runner attempts to promote mock test run to commercial CI_PASS.
tests.mitigationMechanism: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun stamps status: 'CI_NOT_RUN' and level: 'PARSED_CLAIM' for mock runs.

tests.name: Field Tampering Detection — Altered headSha or responseDigest
tests.attackVector: Attacker registers valid run then tampers with headSha or responseDigest in downstream evidence object.
tests.mitigationMechanism: lookupVerifiedRemoteCiRun verifies expectedSha matches registered record; HMAC token verification fails if responseDigest is modified.

tests.name: Server Registry Isolation — Cross-test state leakage prevention
tests.attackVector: Test run records bleeding across vitest worker executions or test boundaries.
tests.mitigationMechanism: clearVerifiedRemoteCiRunsForTesting empties registry between test runs and setup/teardown hooks.

tests.name: Full Gate Safety — Unverified CI strictly prevents overallReleaseAllowed
tests.attackVector: Caller presents ReleaseEvidenceInput with passing unit, integration, and backtest evidence, attempting release with unverified CI claim.
tests.mitigationMechanism: evaluateReleaseEvidence queries lookupVerifiedRemoteCiRun; demotes ciStatus to CI_NOT_RUN, adds CI_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED to blockerList, and enforces overallReleaseAllowed = false.
